intro.h2: Cabinets that solve the problem in front of you
paragraphs: Empire Cabinets builds custom cabinets in Denham Springs, and our customers remember the clever details. One homeowner needed her large stainless-steel stockpot to fit in her walk-in pantry. Ryan customized one cabinet so the pot fits perfectly, without changing the cabinet's overall size.

We bring that kind of problem-solving to new home construction and to remodels alike. We have blended new cabinets into a Hayes Town house so the styles match, enlarged and painted kitchen islands, and given tired cabinets a tune-up with adjusted drawers and new pull-outs. Customers describe the result as expert craftsmanship with real attention to detail.

services.h2: Custom cabinets in Denham Springs and what we build

items.name: Custom kitchens and kitchen design
items.blurb: Full kitchens designed and built for your home: tall painted uppers, glass-front cabinets, a hood surround and a large island. We handle kitchen design for new home construction and for remodels of existing kitchens, starting from how you cook and store things.

image.alt: White custom kitchen with glass-front uppers, double ovens, sage island and brass pendants

items.name: Kitchen islands, new and enlarged
items.blurb: A bigger island changes how a kitchen works. We build new islands and enlarge existing ones, then paint them to match or contrast. One customer had her island enlarged and painted and called it expert craftsmanship.

image.alt: Grey-green painted island with drawers and grey stone top in an open kitchen with wood-look floors

items.name: Pantries, laundry rooms and built-ins
items.blurb: Walk-in pantry cupboards, laundry cabinets above the machines and a built-in desk nook with drawers. We pay close attention to the small custom details you ask for, like a cabinet sized around your biggest pot.

image.alt: Grey built-in desk nook with drawers, white countertop and open wood shelves above

items.name: Matching and tune-ups for existing cabinets
items.blurb: Not every job is new. We add cabinets that blend with what you already have, adjust drawers, add pull-outs and give older cabinetry a much needed tune-up, as we did in a Hayes Town house.

image.alt: Grey laundry room wall cabinets above a white washer and dryer

items.name: New home construction cabinetry
items.blurb: New home construction is the first thing listed on our Facebook page. We build cabinets for new houses while they are going up, like this kitchen with a wine rack and island, so the cabinetry is planned with the build.

image.alt: New home under construction with unfinished wood kitchen cabinets, wine rack and island installed

about.text: Empire Cabinets is a cabinet shop on Prince Charles St in Denham Springs, Louisiana. Customers know us through Ryan, who builds the work and talks through the details with each client. We are licensed and insured, with over 20 years of experience across new home construction, remodels, kitchen design and wood furniture. Our reviews are all about the details: a pantry cabinet sized for a stockpot, an island built to look like the custom piece the homeowner pictured, older drawers adjusted so they run smoothly again. On Google we have 15 reviews with a 5.0 average.
about.owner_role: Cabinet maker named in Google reviews (exact title not published)

steps.title: Call early
steps.text: We open at 6 AM on weekdays. Call (225) 955-0299 and tell us about your kitchen, pantry or new home.

steps.title: Design the details
steps.text: We plan the layout and the small custom details with you, like pull-outs, drawer sizes or a cabinet built around a large pot.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Your cabinets are built to fit your space and your style, whether they must match existing cabinetry or start fresh.

steps.title: Install and paint
steps.text: We install the cabinets and paint them when the job calls for it, as on the islands we have enlarged and painted.

steps.title: Fine tuning
steps.text: Drawers and doors are adjusted until they run right, and we go over the finished work with you.

items.name: Roxane D.
items.text: Ryan did an exceptional job building the cupboards for our walk-in pantry. He was responsive, easy to work with, and paid close attention to the small custom details I wanted. He even came up with a clever way to customize one cabinet so our large stainless-steel pot fits perfectly without changing the cabinet’s overall size. His craftsmanship and problem-solving were impressive. We’re extremely happy with the result and would highly recommend him.

items.name: Joyce R.
items.text: I have a Hayes Town house and was anxious about the quality of the cabinets I wanted to add to the home and modifications to the existing cabinetry. Ryan did a great job of blending the styles and meeting the quality standards I expected. He is very conscientious about his work and his goal is to please his client. In addition to the  cabinets I had him build a new island that looks like the custom piece I hoped it would be. He gave my existing cabinets a much needed tuneup by adjusting drawers and adding pull outs. I highly recommend him.

service_area.h2: Custom cabinets in Denham Springs, LA
service_area.text: Empire Cabinets is based at 9445 Prince Charles St in Denham Springs, LA. We build cabinets for new home construction and for remodels of existing kitchens, pantries and laundry rooms. If you are outside Denham Springs and want to know whether we can take on your project, call (225) 955-0299 and tell us where the house is and what you need built.

items.a: Yes. Empire Cabinets is licensed and insured, and we have over 20 years of experience in new home construction, remodels, kitchen design and wood furniture. Ask us for the details of our licence and insurance when we talk about your project.

items.q: Can you add cabinets that match my existing ones?
items.a: Yes. In a Hayes Town house, Ryan added new cabinets, modified the existing cabinetry and blended the styles so they met the owner's quality standards. He also adjusted drawers and added pull-outs to the older cabinets while he was there.

Yes, new and enlarged. One customer had her island enlarged and the cabinets painted, and another had a new island built that looks like the custom piece she hoped for. Tell us the size you want and how you plan to use it.

items.q: Do you work on new homes?
items.a: Yes. New home construction is one of the things we do, along with remodels, kitchen design and wood furniture. If you are building, call early in the process so the cabinetry can be planned along with the rest of the house.

Monday to Friday from 6 AM to 7 PM and Saturday from 7 AM to 4 PM. We are closed on Sunday. Early hours make it easy to call before work at (225) 955-0299 and talk through your project, or to set a time for us to look at your kitchen.

final_cta.h2: Let's build cabinets that fit the way you live
final_cta.text: Call Ryan at Empire Cabinets and talk through your kitchen, pantry or new home.
